# Method Classification Framework

```{r method_categories}
# Comprehensive method categories with hierarchical structure
method_categories <- list(

    subcategory_1 = c("uncertainty quantification", "uncertainty propagation", "epistemic uncertainty"),
    subcategory_2 = c("sensitivity analysis", "global sensitivity", "tornado diagram"),
    subcategory_3 = c("scenario analysis", "latin hypercube", "importance sampling"),

# Enhanced detection function for hierarchical classification
detect_methods_hierarchical <- function(text, categories = method_categories) {
  if(is.na(text) || text == "" || length(text) == 0) return(list())

  text_lower <- tolower(as.character(text))
  detected_methods <- list()

  for(method_name in names(categories)) {
    category_data <- categories[[method_name]]
    all_keywords <- unlist(category_data[c("main_methods", "subcategory_1", "subcategory_2", "subcategory_3")])

    # Create word boundary patterns
    patterns <- paste0("\\b", all_keywords, "\\b")

    # Check for matches
    matches <- str_detect(text_lower, patterns)

    if(any(matches)) {
      matched_keywords <- all_keywords[matches]

      # Classify into subcategories
      main_match <- any(matched_keywords %in% category_data$main_methods)
      sub1_match <- any(matched_keywords %in% category_data$subcategory_1)
      sub2_match <- any(matched_keywords %in% category_data$subcategory_2)
      sub3_match <- any(matched_keywords %in% category_data$subcategory_3)

      detected_methods[[method_name]] <- list(
        main = main_match,
        subcategory_1 = sub1_match,
        subcategory_2 = sub2_match,
        subcategory_3 = sub3_match,
        matched_keywords = matched_keywords,
        description = category_data$description
      )
    }
  }

  return(detected_methods)
}

# Function to get primary method category
get_primary_method <- function(detected_methods_list) {
  if(length(detected_methods_list) == 0) return("No Methods Detected")

  # Prioritize methods with main category matches
  main_matches <- names(detected_methods_list)[sapply(detected_methods_list, function(x) x$main)]

  if(length(main_matches) > 0) {
    return(main_matches[1])  # Return first main match
  } else {
    return(names(detected_methods_list)[1])  # Return first subcategory match
  }
}
```

# Data Processing and Analysis

```{r load_and_process}
# Load and process bibliographic data
if(file.exists("qs/Bib_valid_only.qs")) {
  message("Loading bibliographic data...")
  bib_data <- qs::qread("qs/Bib_valid_only.qs")

  # Clean and prepare data
  clean_bib_data <- bib_data %>%
    filter(!is.na(TITLE), TITLE != "") %>%
    mutate(
      full_text = paste(
        ifelse(is.na(TITLE), "", TITLE),
        ifelse(is.na(ABSTRACT), "", ABSTRACT),
        ifelse(is.na(KEYWORDS), "", KEYWORDS),
        sep = " "
      ),
      YEAR = as.numeric(YEAR),
      AUTHORS = ifelse(is.na(AUTHOR), "", AUTHOR),
      BIBREF = ifelse(is.na(BIBTEXKEY), paste0("ref_", row_number()), BIBTEXKEY)
    ) %>%
    filter(YEAR >= 1970, YEAR <= 2025) %>%
    filter(!str_detect(tolower(TITLE), "\\b(catalog|syllabus|annual report|bibliography)\\b"))

  message("Processing ", nrow(clean_bib_data), " papers...")

  # Apply hierarchical method detection
  detected_methods_list <- map(clean_bib_data$full_text, detect_methods_hierarchical)

  # Create comprehensive results
  comprehensive_results <- clean_bib_data %>%
    mutate(
      detected_methods = detected_methods_list,
      primary_method = map_chr(detected_methods, get_primary_method),
      has_methods = map_lgl(detected_methods, function(x) length(x) > 0)
    )

  message("Method detection completed: ", sum(comprehensive_results$has_methods), " papers with methods")

} else {
  stop("Bibliographic data file not found: qs/Bib_valid_only.qs")
}
```

# Generate CSV Output

```{r generate_csv}
# Create the requested CSV with hierarchical method classification
csv_output <- comprehensive_results %>%
  filter(has_methods) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    # Get subcategories for primary method
    subcategories = {
      if(primary_method != "No Methods Detected" && primary_method %in% names(detected_methods)) {
        method_data <- detected_methods[[primary_method]]
        subs <- character()

        if(method_data$subcategory_1) {
          sub1_keywords <- intersect(method_data$matched_keywords,
                                   method_categories[[primary_method]]$subcategory_1)
          if(length(sub1_keywords) > 0) subs <- c(subs, sub1_keywords[1])
        }

        if(method_data$subcategory_2) {
          sub2_keywords <- intersect(method_data$matched_keywords,
                                   method_categories[[primary_method]]$subcategory_2)
          if(length(sub2_keywords) > 0) subs <- c(subs, sub2_keywords[1])
        }

        if(method_data$subcategory_3) {
          sub3_keywords <- intersect(method_data$matched_keywords,
                                   method_categories[[primary_method]]$subcategory_3)
          if(length(sub3_keywords) > 0) subs <- c(subs, sub3_keywords[1])
        }

        # Pad with empty strings to ensure 3 subcategories
        c(subs, rep("", 3))[1:3]
      } else {
        c("", "", "")
      }
    },

    method_description = {
      if(primary_method != "No Methods Detected" && primary_method %in% names(method_categories)) {
        method_categories[[primary_method]]$description
      } else {
        ""
      }
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select(BIBREF, primary_method, subcategories, method_description) %>%
  mutate(
    subcategory_1 = map_chr(subcategories, function(x) x[1]),
    subcategory_2 = map_chr(subcategories, function(x) x[2]),
    subcategory_3 = map_chr(subcategories, function(x) x[3])
  ) %>%
  select(
    bibref = BIBREF,
    main_method_category = primary_method,
    subcategory_1,
    subcategory_2,
    subcategory_3,
    method_description
  )

# Write CSV
write.csv(csv_output, "methods_classification.csv", row.names = FALSE, na = "")

message("Generated methods_classification.csv with ", nrow(csv_output), " classified papers")

# Display preview
head(csv_output, 10) %>%
  kable(caption = "Preview of Methods Classification CSV") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"), font_size = 12)
```

# Sankey Visualizations

```{r sankey_plots}
# Source the plotting function
source("R/plot_sankey.R")

# Create decade-specific Sankey plots with consistent formatting
create_decade_sankey_consistent <- function(data, target_decade, top_n = 8) {
  decade_data <- data %>%
    mutate(decade = floor(YEAR/10)*10) %>%
    filter(decade == target_decade, has_methods)

  if(nrow(decade_data) == 0) {
    message("No data for decade ", target_decade)
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Count primary methods for this decade
  method_counts <- decade_data %>%
    count(primary_method, sort = TRUE) %>%
    head(top_n)

  total_papers <- nrow(decade_data)

  # Prepare for sankey
  inputs <- c(total_papers, 0)
  losses <- method_counts$n

  # Create consistent labels with fixed text size
  method_labels <- sapply(method_counts$primary_method, function(x) {
    # Intelligent abbreviation for consistency
    if(nchar(x) > 20) {
      words <- str_split(x, "[\\s/]")[[1]]
      if(length(words) > 1) {
        # Take first 3-4 chars of each word
        paste(substr(words[1:min(3, length(words))], 1, 4), collapse = "")
      } else {
        paste0(substr(x, 1, 17), "...")
      }
    } else {
      x
    }
  })

  labels <- c(
    paste0(target_decade, "s\n(n=", format(total_papers, big.mark = ","), ")"),
    "",
    method_labels
  )

  # Set consistent plot parameters
  pdf(paste0("sankey_", target_decade, ".pdf"), width = 10, height = 6)
  par(cex = 0.8, cex.main = 1.0, cex.lab = 0.8, cex.axis = 0.8)

  # Generate the plot with consistent styling
  plot_sankey(inputs, losses, "Papers", labels)

  # Add consistent title
  title(main = paste0("Decision Methods in ", target_decade, "s Literature"),
        cex.main = 1.2, font.main = 2)

  dev.off()

  message("Created Sankey plot for ", target_decade, "s")

  return(list(
    decade = target_decade,
    total_papers = total_papers,
    method_counts = method_counts
  ))
}

# Generate Sankey plots for each decade
decades <- seq(1970, 2020, 10)
sankey_results <- map(decades, ~create_decade_sankey_consistent(comprehensive_results, .x))
names(sankey_results) <- paste0(decades, "s")

# Remove NULL results
sankey_results <- sankey_results[!sapply(sankey_results, is.null)]

# Display decade summaries
decade_summary <- map_dfr(sankey_results, function(x) {
  if(!is.null(x)) {
    data.frame(
      decade = paste0(x$decade, "s"),
      total_papers = x$total_papers,
      top_method = x$method_counts$primary_method[1],
      top_method_count = x$method_counts$n[1]
    )
  }
})

decade_summary %>%
  rename(
    Decade = decade,
    `Total Papers` = total_papers,
    `Top Method` = top_method,
    `Count` = top_method_count
  ) %>%
  kable(caption = "Sankey Plot Summary by Decade") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))
```

# Summary Statistics

```{r summary_stats}
# Overall statistics
total_papers <- nrow(comprehensive_results)
papers_with_methods <- sum(comprehensive_results$has_methods)
detection_rate <- round(papers_with_methods / total_papers * 100, 1)

# Method category distribution
method_distribution <- comprehensive_results %>%
  filter(has_methods) %>%
  count(primary_method, sort = TRUE) %>%
  mutate(
    percentage = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)
  )

cat("## Analysis Summary\n\n")
cat("- **Total Papers Analyzed:** ", format(total_papers, big.mark = ","), "\n")
cat("- **Papers with Methods:** ", format(papers_with_methods, big.mark = ","),
    " (", detection_rate, "%)\n")
cat("- **Method Categories:** ", length(method_categories), "\n")
cat("- **Years Covered:** ", min(comprehensive_results$YEAR, na.rm = TRUE),
    " - ", max(comprehensive_results$YEAR, na.rm = TRUE), "\n\n")

cat("## Top Method Categories\n\n")
method_distribution %>%
  head(10) %>%
  mutate(
    Method = primary_method,
    Papers = format(n, big.mark = ","),
    Percentage = paste0(percentage, "%")
  ) %>%
  select(Method, Papers, Percentage) %>%
  kable() %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover"))

cat("\n## Generated Files\n\n")
cat("1. **methods_classification.csv** - Hierarchical method classifications\n")
cat("2. **sankey_[decade].pdf** - Method distribution plots by decade\n")
cat("3. **index.html** - This comprehensive analysis report\n")
```
